news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Just Reported And Analysts Have Been Lifting Their Price Targets
Earnings Update: Here's Why Analysts Just Lifted Their Nektar Therapeutics Price Target To US$153
news.summary: Following the Q2 print, the analyst consensus price target moved up to roughly $153, with the sell-side rating NKTR a Strong Buy (about 11 covering analysts, no sell ratings). B. Riley lifted its target to $150 from $105 and Citi moved higher as well, leaving the consensus roughly 100% above the current share price near $76.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Quarterly revenue fell 9.4% year over year to $10.13 million and the trailing 12-month net loss widened 28.5% to $157.13 million, keeping investor focus on burn even as the Phase 3 program ramps. Shares fell in the days after earnings despite the EPS beat and the raised year-end cash guidance.

news.headline: Nektar Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Lag, Pipeline in Focus
news.summary: Nektar posted a Q2 loss of $1.23 per share versus a consensus loss of about $2.06, a large beat, while revenue of $10.1 million slightly missed the $10.4 million estimate. The story on the print was almost entirely pipeline: the ZENITH AD Phase 3 program in atopic dermatitis and the planned registrational alopecia areata study, both fully funded by the strengthened balance sheet.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026, versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss narrowed to $40.6 million ($1.23/share), and CEO Howard Robin reaffirmed the Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027 and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Coverage of Nektar Therapeutics with Buy Rating and $153 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity started NKTR at Buy with a $153 target one day after the Phase 3 launch, adding to a broadly constructive sell-side. Targets remain widely dispersed, from around $80 on the cautious end to Piper Sandler's $192.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar started ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program with a third study in treatment-experienced patients to follow. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, and targets initial topline data in mid-2028 with a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin by late September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population.

catalysts.label: Additional REZOLVE-AD / REZOLVE-AA data at medical conferences
catalysts.detail: Nektar has signalled further presentations of longer-term Phase 2b atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata data, including off-treatment durability after discontinuation in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Durability of the Treg effect off drug remains a key swing factor ahead of the AA Phase 3 start.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against the raised year-end guidance of $815-840 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start and early enrollment, and detail preparations for the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3. Exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 study in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data. This adds a second, funded value driver alongside atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway now extends into Q3 2028, covering this readout without a further raise.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with the EMA in parallel, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar is now a pure late-stage rezpeg story with the funding question largely answered: Q2 2026 (August 13) showed $1.02 billion in cash and investments and runway into Q3 2028, comfortably past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout, and management reaffirmed the ZENITH AD-3 start for late September 2026 plus a registrational alopecia areata study in early 2027. The market reaction was mixed - a big EPS beat but a small revenue miss and a widening loss from the Phase 3 ramp, and the stock slid after the print before stabilising around $76 on August 19, still far below the 52-week high near $109. The sell-side went the other way, lifting the consensus target to roughly $153 (B. Riley to $150, Piper Sandler at $192 on the high end) with a Strong Buy consensus, so the near-term gap is sentiment and burn versus a catalyst calendar that is thin until the AD-3 enrollment updates and any H2 durability data.
